title: Design System: Next Gen Water Systems

display.purpose: The hero line and the booking headline. Satoshi Medium, tight, balanced wrap; the biggest line on the page carries the lightest weight.

headline.purpose: Section headings, two lines with a hard break. Medium weight at -0.03em.

beat.purpose: The journey's copy beats, forming out of water as each stage opens. The one bold headline tier.

title.purpose: Stage names, spec keys, block headings on the sheets, note headings, footer index titles. Satoshi Bold at reading sizes.

lead.purpose: The one sentence under a headline, in Second Ink, on a 42 to 52ch measure.

body.purpose: Prose on the interior sheets at 66ch. Row values and panel copy sit at 16px and 15.5px.

label.purpose: Caption heads and keys: Hanken 500, sentence case, zero tracking, Third Ink. Stage numbers take Action Blue.

caption.purpose: Breadcrumbs, photo notes, form field labels, 'or call', the nav hint. Hanken 400 at 13px.

action.purpose: The pill's label. Satoshi 600 resolves to the Bold file; the nav pill is 14px.

shadows.name: action
shadows.purpose: Under the blue pill, tinted with its own colour. The only coloured shadow.

shadows.name: floating-card
shadows.purpose: The phone journey card; the phone menu sheet uses 0 22px 44px -22px rgba(28, 31, 34, 0.38) with an inset hairline.

shadows.name: chrome-rail
shadows.purpose: The journey rail card over the studio, with backdrop-filter: blur(6px).

shadows.name: chrome-hint
shadows.purpose: The nav hint over the studio, with backdrop-filter: blur(8px).

shadows.name: nav-seat
shadows.purpose: The header's frosted pane (backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(140%) brightness(1.03)) while attached; cross-fades to 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(28, 31, 34, 0.32) once detached.

motion.name: ease-fluid
motion.purpose: --ease. Default easing for fills, borders, opacity and the skip link.

motion.name: ease-open
motion.purpose: Accordion panels (stages, schedule) opening to a measured pixel height, then released to auto.

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: The phone menu sheet dropping under the bar.

motion.name: fill-change
motion.purpose: Button and chip state changes; fill and border only, no transform.

motion.name: nav-detach
motion.purpose: Scroll distance over which the header bar becomes the floating pill; the morph is interpolated per frame.

motion.name: nav-spring
motion.purpose: The journey scalar's spring, integrated against real time, so entering and leaving the journey overshoots slightly and settles in about half a second.

motion.name: journey-scrub
motion.purpose: ScrollTrigger scrub on the pinned journey.

motion.name: hero-hint-delay
motion.purpose: The drag hint appears once per session, this long after the live machine is up.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: journey and scene display: none; StaticStory display: block
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion the pinned journey and the fixed scene are removed and the same story renders as a document with a still per stage.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The one filled pill per surface: hero, booking submit, the sheets' closing card. Action Blue, Satoshi 600, Deep Blue on hover, Cover Ink focus ring.
components.html: Book a free water test
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 16px 28px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #0b62b8); color: #fff; font-family: 'Satoshi', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15.5px; letter-spacing: 0; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -12px rgba(11, 98, 184, 0.7); transition: background 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: var(--deep, #094a8a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #17191c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav action
components.description: The same treatment at the header's scale: 9px 16px, 14px, Satoshi 600.
components.css: .ds-btn-nav { display: inline-block; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #0b62b8); color: #fff; font-family: 'Satoshi', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -12px rgba(11, 98, 184, 0.7); transition: background 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-nav:hover, .ds-btn-nav:focus-visible { background: var(--deep, #094a8a); } .ds-btn-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #17191c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet outline
components.description: A hairline pill for the second action on a surface: 'Watch this stage open', the breadcrumb's Home. Fills 5% ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(23, 25, 28, 0.12)); border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #3e4348); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover, .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { background: rgba(28, 31, 34, 0.05); border-color: rgba(28, 31, 34, 0.34); color: var(--ink, #17191c); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0b62b8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet link
components.description: 'See inside it': Hanken 500 in Second Ink with a drawn chevron, Action Blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-more { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #3e4348); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-link-more i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; rotate: 45deg; translate: 0 -2px; } .ds-link-more:hover, .ds-link-more:focus-visible { color: var(--accent, #0b62b8); } .ds-link-more:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0b62b8); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Taste chip
components.description: A pill on 72% paper with a drawn tick-box. Ticked: Cover Ink text, accent border, the box fills; the latest tick takes a 12% Water fill.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 13px 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(23, 25, 28, 0.12)); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(248, 249, 249, 0.72); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--ink-2, #3e4348); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip i { position: relative; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-3, #676e75); border-radius: 1px; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip i::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2px; background: var(--accent, #0b62b8); transform: scale(0); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(28, 31, 34, 0.32); color: var(--ink, #17191c); } .ds-chip.is-on { color: var(--ink, #17191c); border-color: rgba(0, 110, 156, 0.55); } .ds-chip.is-on i { border-color: var(--accent, #0b62b8); } .ds-chip.is-on i::after { transform: scale(1); } .ds-chip.is-live { background: rgba(27, 166, 217, 0.12); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0b62b8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Paper fill, half-ink edge, square corners, a 13px sentence-case caption above. Focus turns the edge and a 1px ring Action Blue.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; max-width: 320px; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--ink-3, #676e75); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(28, 31, 34, 0.5); border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel, #f6f7f7); color: var(--ink, #17191c); caret-color: var(--accent, #0b62b8); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #676e75); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #0b62b8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #0b62b8); }

components.name: Hint pill
components.description: The small floating pill over the studio: 'Drag to turn · tap to open', the stage marker, the nav hint. 86% white, hairline, a 7px Water dot.
components.html: Drag to turn · tap to open
components.css: .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(23, 25, 28, 0.12)); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #3e4348); white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -10px rgba(28, 31, 34, 0.3); } .ds-hint i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--water, #2ea9df); }

components.name: Placeholder mark
components.description: The visible red placeholder for any figure without a source. Redline on a 10% tint with a dashed edge; never a plausible number.

components.css: .ds-rows { margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 560px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink, #17191c); background: var(--panel, #f6f7f7); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 190px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; padding: 13px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(23, 25, 28, 0.12)); } .ds-row dt { padding-top: 3px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--ink-3, #676e75); } .ds-row dd { margin: 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink, #17191c); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Stage bar
components.description: One row of the stages list: the stage number in Action Blue Label, the name in Title, what goes in, and a drawn plus that turns to a minus when open.
components.css: .ds-stage { width: 100%; max-width: 760px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4em minmax(0, 13em) minmax(0, 1fr) 1.5em; align-items: baseline; gap: 18px; padding: 20px 20px 20px 2px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(23, 25, 28, 0.12)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(23, 25, 28, 0.12)); background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stage-n { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--accent, #0b62b8); } .ds-stage-name { font-family: 'Satoshi', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(17px, 2vw, 21px); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #17191c); } .ds-stage-in { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink-3, #676e75); } .ds-stage i { position: relative; justify-self: end; align-self: center; width: 13px; height: 13px; } .ds-stage i::before, .ds-stage i::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 50% 0 auto; height: 1.5px; background: var(--accent, #0b62b8); transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-stage i::after { inset: 0 auto auto 50%; width: 1.5px; height: 100%; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-stage:hover .ds-stage-name, .ds-stage:focus-visible .ds-stage-name { color: var(--accent, #0b62b8); } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0b62b8); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A product photography studio with the page as its backdrop. The page is white. The machine stands in a pale grey field that one fixed WebGL scene paints behind the whole document, and the hero and the journey are the two windows onto it. The type is the charcoal of the cover's own lettering. There is one blue, and it is spent on the action. Everything else is a hairline or a sheet of paper.

The register is premium restraint (PRODUCT.md): closer to an appliance launch than to a plumbing site. Density is low. Each screen owns one idea, set in a big medium-weight line with a short sentence under it, and the proof sits in hairline rows rather than cards. Motion belongs to the machine. The cover turns under a drag and lifts under a tap; each stage opens in section on the scroll. The chrome around it stays still.

Confirmed rejections, from the 17 Sep 2026 direction contract and PRODUCT.md: the blue water-splash hero, the three feature cards, the stats band and the testimonial carousel of the category; the drawing-set furniture of the world this page replaced (sheet strips, sheet numbers, registration ticks, drafting labels); and the wellness aesthetic (sage, blush, rounded friendly type, droplets as decoration). Three rules from the previous world survive in changed form and are marked below as carried over.
keyCharacteristics: White page, pale studio, charcoal ink, one blue.
The product is live in the first viewport and is the only picture that matters.
Satoshi Medium for the big lines; Hanken for sentences and for every label, in sentence case.
Flat paper: a shadow only where something floats over the page.
A visible red placeholder wherever a figure has no source.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Action Blue is spent on the action and on what leads to it: one pill per surface, inline links, the stage numbers that index the journey. It never tints a background, a heading or a decoration. Two blue pills on one screen means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Water Is Never Text Rule
rules.body: Carried over from the previous world. Water marks water: a selection, a live dot, the fill under a live chip, a heading forming out of water. At 2.7:1 on white it is never a word.

rules.name: The Red Means Unsourced Rule
rules.body: A figure without a source is set as a red dashed `[PLACEHOLDER]` mark. It is never replaced with a plausible number and never softened to grey.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Satoshi sets headings and the action. Hanken sets everything else, every label included. No third face appears on a text surface: Geist Mono is loaded, and the build points `--font-mono` and `--font-draft` at Hanken so that it cannot be used.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and keys are sentence case with zero tracking. No uppercase, no tracked small caps, no monospace for keys or numbers. Tabular figures are the only numeric treatment.

rules.name: The Medium Weight Rule
rules.body: The bigger the line, the lighter the weight. Display and headline sit at 500 with tight tracking; 700 belongs to the title tier and to the journey beats.

rules.name: The One Scene Rule
rules.body: The machine is one WebGL scene fixed behind the page. The hero and the journey are windows onto it and paint nothing; every other section is opaque. A new section that lets the studio show through is a bug.

rules.name: The Hairline Row Rule
rules.body: Carried over from the previous world's Hairline Rule. Facts go in rows: key on the left, value on the right, a hairline between rows, one solid Cover Ink rule at the top of a table. Cards are not used for facts.

rules.name: The Floating Paper Rule
rules.body: Carried over from the previous world's Paper-and-Glass Rule. A shadow says the element is off the page. It says nothing about importance. Rows, tables, fields and notes are flat; only the action, a floating card, a framed figure and the chrome over the studio cast one.

dos: Do give every surface one filled pill in Action Blue, and make everything else on it a hairline or a text link.
Do set the big line in Satoshi Medium (500) at -0.03em or tighter, wrapped to two lines with a hard break, with one Hanken sentence under it in Second Ink.
Do set labels and keys in Hanken 500 at 13.5px, sentence case, zero tracking, Third Ink.
Do put facts in hairline rows with a solid ink top rule, key left and value right, tabular figures.
Do keep the machine live: the scene is the picture, and a raster stands in only until WebGL is up or when motion is reduced.
Do mark any unsourced figure with the red dashed `[PLACEHOLDER]`, and caption a generated image as a visualisation where it is shown.
Do paint an opaque ground on every new section, so the studio shows only through the hero and the journey.
Do keep the reduced-motion path whole: no pinned journey, no scene, the same story as a document with a still per stage.
donts: Don't introduce a third blue, a gradient or a blue background; Action Blue fills the action and colours links, Water marks water.
Don't set type in Water; it is 2.7:1 on white.
Don't use a monospace or drafting face, tracked uppercase, sheet numbers, sheet strips or registration ticks; the drawing set is retired.
Don't put a scrim, a halo or a text shadow behind copy over the studio; move the copy or step the camera aside.
Don't build a feature-card grid, a stats band or a testimonial carousel; the direction contract refuses the category's furniture.
Don't drift toward wellness: no sage or blush, no rounded friendly type, no droplets or leaves as decoration.
Don't quote a reduction percentage or any figure without a source document; describe the mechanism instead.
Don't let a button lift, scale or shimmer; state changes are fill changes.
